bio_en: Arshak Sanosian, known as Grgo, was born in Gumushkhane in 1870 and studied at the national school in Trabzon until 1885. After two years in the regions of Van and Mush he returned to Trabzon and moved with his family to Constantinople, where at the end of 1892 he became one of the first sympathisers of the newly founded ARF, soon devoting himself entirely to the revolution. He was arrested in Edirne, where he had gone to carry out an undertaking, and in 1898 had to leave Constantinople for the Caucasus and later America. He died on 24 June 1904 in Varna after diving into shallow water.
